# PT Andalan Satu Nusantara (Astara)

Astara is a technology integration company based in Jakarta, Indonesia. We deliver end-to-end technology solutions including hardware, software, infrastructure, and UI/UX design.

## Services

- IT Outsourcing Partner
- Interactive Chair & Mechatronics (Racing Simulator 2DOF / 3DOF)
- Smartboard Interactive
- LED Videotron Display
- GSM Jammer
- GSM / LTE BTS
- IMSI Catcher
